description: Election Commission - Mrs. H. A. D. D. N. Karunarathna and Mr.  W. A. S. S. Gunasingha have been removed from the Bandaragama P/S
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
